text: 查理已经离开。但只要伯纳德还可能活着，你当然不能丢下他。就在这时，一声清晰的呼喊从上方传来。你抬头望向天空。
“我的脚！我燃烧的脚！我的心！”那哀号突然中断。你听见有什么沉重物体从树冠间坠下，撞断枝干，一路砸向地面。
你让其他人拿好枪。你站在火边，手指紧张地搭在扳机上。几个小时过去，终于传来一声树枝断裂声，接着又是一声。不紧不慢地，有什么东西从灌木丛中走了出来。
若一看见身影就开枪，前往 138。若要让它走近一些，前往 101。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 95
text: Charlie is gone. But of course, you cannot abandon Bernard whilst there is a chance of finding him alive. At that moment, a clear cry rings from above. You look to the sky.
“My feet! My flaming feet! My heart!” The plaintive call cuts off abruptly and you hear something heavy crashing down through the treetops, breaking branches as it plummets.
You tell the others to get their guns. You stand over the fire, a nervous finger on your trigger. Hours pass. Finally, a twig snaps. Then another. Unhurried, something steps from the bush.
To shoot at the first sight of the figure, go to 138. To let it come closer, go to 101.
